other_failure_modes.name: Imputing test data using test set statistics
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates imputation statistics (like the median) independently on the test set rather than applying the statistics learned from the training set. This violates the assumption that the test set is purely unseen data and can cause inconsistent predictions depending on the test set's distribution.

summary: The agent provides a basic but functional LightGBM regression script with elementary data cleaning. However, it completely lacks an internal validation strategy (FM06), skips feature engineering (FM07), and improperly calculates imputation statistics directly on the test set rather than reusing statistics fitted on the training set.
